assertions.reason: Unauthenticated API behavior is correct (401) and authenticated behavior works, but the app did not prompt for a bearer token when none was stored; instead Workspace showed 'missing bearer token'.
Embedded dashboard index and static JS/CSS assets were served successfully from /dashboard and /dashboard/static with HTTP 200.

Help page deep-linking and copy-link behavior did not meet contract: '?topic=secrets' still rendered Getting Started, search for existing topic 'faq' returned 'No topics match your search', and copy-link showed 'Unable to copy topic link'.
Workspace page showed breadcrumb/root context, entry count, filter, auto-refresh toggle, Up/Refresh controls, and file preview metadata/content after selecting a file.
Secrets page rendered key list/search, copy-name and delete controls, write-only add form, naming guidance with Use key actions, and API GET /api/admin/secrets returned 200.
Docs page rendered agent/document selectors, editor controls (save/reload), unsaved indicator after local edit, agent switch behavior, and API GET /api/admin/agent/docs returned 200.
Skills page rendered agent selector, installable skills with install controls, activation controls, reload action, and API GET /api/admin/skills returned 200.
Under offline/network-failure simulation, Workspace/Secrets/Docs/Skills showed user-facing failure messages and retry/reload actions (Refresh/Retry/Reload), with no white-screen state observed.

frictions.description: Clipboard read access is denied in this headless validation environment, so copy-link verification relied on in-app notification text.
frictions.resolution: Used UI notification evidence ('Unable to copy topic link.') captured from page text.

frictions.description: Tokenless-path verification required explicit localStorage clear + full reload; route-only navigation retained in-memory app state.
frictions.resolution: Forced full reload after storage clear to capture unauthenticated workspace error state.

summary: Tested 8 assigned assertions: 6 passed, 2 failed (VAL-REACT-FND-003, VAL-REACT-FND-009).
